edges.reason: owner() checks msg.sender against stored owner for authorization.
transferOwnership is onlyOwner and uses msg.sender for access control.
_relayTokens uses msg.sender as the source of tokens in transferFrom.
onTokenTransfer receives msg.sender as the token contract caller.
msg.sender is indirectly used via _from parameter in bridge actions.
fixFailedMessage uses onlyMediator which checks msg.sender == bridgeContract.
claimTokens uses onlyIfUpgradeabilityOwner checking msg.sender.
setDailyLimit is onlyOwner and uses msg.sender for access control.
getCurrentDay uses now (block.timestamp) for day calculation, causing timestamp dependency.
owner() reads addressStorage[OWNER].
_setOwner writes to addressStorage[OWNER].
withinLimit reads uintStorage for dailyLimit, maxPerTx, minPerTx, and totalSpentPerDay.
addTotalSpentPerDay writes to uintStorage for totalSpentPerDay.
_setMediatorBalance writes to uintStorage for mediatorBalance.
setLock writes to boolStorage[LOCK].
lock reads from boolStorage[LOCK].
_value parameter is the amount of tokens to bridge in _relayTokens.
_value parameter is the transferred amount in onTokenTransfer.
_value is used in bridge logic to compute valueToBridge.
_receiver parameter is the target address on the other network.
_token parameter is the ERC677 token contract to bridge.
_from parameter is the original token sender.
_data parameter may contain an alternative receiver.
_messageId parameter identifies the failed message to fix.
_to parameter is the receiver in claimValues.
_recipient parameter is the address to mint or transfer to.
_feeType parameter selects the fee direction in _distributeFee.
transferOwnership calls _setOwner.
_relayTokens calls bridgeSpecificActionsOnTokenTransfer.
_relayTokens calls withinLimit.
_relayTokens calls addTotalSpentPerDay.
onTokenTransfer calls bridgeSpecificActionsOnTokenTransfer.
onTokenTransfer calls withinLimit.
onTokenTransfer calls addTotalSpentPerDay.
bridgeSpecificActionsOnTokenTransfer calls passMessage.
bridgeSpecificActionsOnTokenTransfer calls _distributeFee to collect fee.
passMessage calls bridge.requireToPassMessage.
handleBridgedTokens calls executeActionOnBridgedTokens.
executeActionOnBridgedTokens calls _distributeFee.
executeActionOnFixedTokens calls token.mint, an external call.
fixFailedMessage calls executeActionOnFixedTokens.
claimTokens calls claimValues.
claimValues calls safeSendValue which sends native tokens.
claimValues calls safeTransfer for ERC20 tokens.
_distributeFee calls calculateFee.
_distributeFee calls random if remainder exists.
_distributeFee calls ERC677.transfer for fee distribution.
_distributeFee calls mint for foreign-to-home fee distribution.
withinLimit calls getCurrentDay.
addTotalSpentPerDay uses getCurrentDay from caller but not internally; kept for flow completeness.
_setMediatorBalance writes to uintStorage.
safeTransfer performs an external ERC20 transfer.
safeTransferFrom performs an external ERC20 transferFrom.
safeSendValue may deploy a Sacrifice contract that selfdestructs.
proxy fallback uses delegatecall to forward calls.
fixMediatorBalance calls bridge.requireToPassMessage.
deployAndHandleBridgedTokens calls handleBridgedTokens.
ERC677 transferFrom triggers onTokenTransfer callback, enabling reentrancy if lock is not set.
ERC677 transfer with data can trigger onTokenTransfer callback.
Mint on some tokens may trigger onTokenTransfer callback.
Burn on some tokens may trigger onTokenTransfer callback.

normalization_plan.reason: _value parameter is consumed by _relayTokens and used across bridge logic.
valueToBridge local variable is computed and used in bridgeSpecificActionsOnTokenTransfer.
fee local variable is computed and used in bridgeSpecificActionsOnTokenTransfer.
homeToken local variable is created and used in deployAndHandleBridgedTokens.
_messageId local variable is used in executeActionOnBridgedTokens.
data local variable is built and used in passMessage.
